stairs.title: Crypt stairs
stairs.text: Worn steps lead down from a square of grey daylight, but the way back up has caved in behind you. A brazier smoulders beside an iron-bound arch to the north.

hall.title: Hall of pillars
hall.text: Cracked pillars hold up a vaulted ceiling. Passages open to the east and west. A skeleton in rusted mail stands guard before an archway to the north, its jaw clicking.

variants.text: Cracked pillars hold up a vaulted ceiling. Passages open to the east and west. Bones lie scattered before the archway to the north.

north.locked_text: The skeleton steps into your path and raises a notched blade. It will not let you pass.

armory.title: Armory
armory.text: Empty weapon racks line the walls. Most of what hung here rusted away long ago.

ossuary.title: Ossuary
ossuary.text: Skulls are stacked from floor to ceiling in neat rows. A stone altar stands at the far wall.
ossuary.dark_text: It is pitch black. Something skitters away from your feet.

antechamber.title: Antechamber
antechamber.text: A narrow chamber ends in a door of black stone, fitted with a small silver lock.

north.locked_text: The black door is locked. The lock is small and silver.

vault.title: Vault
vault.text: Gold coins spill from split chests, and a jeweled crown rests on a plinth. You've reached the heart of the crypt.

torch.name: torch
torch.text: A length of pitch-soaked wood, wrapped in rags at one end.

sword.name: notched shortsword
sword.text: Old iron, still sharp along most of its edge.

vellum.name: scrap of vellum
vellum.text: Faded ink: 'The silver key rests with the dead, west of the hall. Bring fire.'

key.name: silver key
key.text: A small silver key, cold to the touch.

crown.name: jeweled crown
crown.text: Gold set with rubies. Heavier than it looks.

interactions.text: light the torch in the brazier
interactions.says: You hold the torch to the coals. It catches with a hiss and throws orange light across the stone.

interactions.text: attack the skeleton with the shortsword
interactions.says: You swing hard. The blade cracks through old bone, and the skeleton collapses across the floor. The archway north is clear.

interactions.text: unlock the black door with the silver key
interactions.says: The key turns with a soft click. The black door swings inward.
